question: Pointing towards Sonu, Riya said, "His mother is the only daughter of my mother." How is the Riya related to the Sonu?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Given: “His mother is the only daughter of my mother.”

Now, Only daughter of my mother = Riya herself

So, Sonu’s mother = Riya

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54eeabf76908ad75aa1a84a46c8d577979ba99f9821b339dde2a175cbf08fe15.png] 

Thus, Riya is Sonu’s mother.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
